components.name: CLI
components.purpose: Human/agent interface for scan, toolchain, audit, bounded context, deterministic verification contract, verification result, and benchmark operations.

components.name: Repository Scanner
components.purpose: Walk repository content deterministically while excluding common generated/dependency directories.

components.name: Language Registry
components.purpose: Map source extensions to language identities without semantic-analysis claims.

components.name: Toolchain Registry
components.purpose: Detect compilers/runtimes and project manifests conservatively.

components.name: Detector Engine
components.purpose: Execute registered deterministic language analyzers, skip explicitly unavailable optional analyzers, and provide stable finding ordering.

components.name: Go Built-in Analyzer
owns: binding-aware related-reference discovery for top-level non-method functions
components.purpose: Provide deliberately narrow high-signal Go rules with regression, adversarial, repository-shaped, and bounded real-world label evidence.

components.name: Evidence Reducer
components.purpose: Turn a selected deterministic finding into a tokenizer-independent bounded byte packet with primary source and optional Go/Python related context while enforcing repository-contained source reads.

components.name: Precision Benchmark Harness
components.purpose: Evaluate labeled Go and Python corpora, count TP/FP/FN, compute corpus-scoped precision/recall, and block regressions at declared thresholds.

components.name: Pinned Public Repository Validator
components.purpose: Run the Go analyzer against exact-SHA public repository snapshots and enforce selected compatibility and safety assertions without converting unlabeled results into precision claims.

components.name: Bounded Real-World Label Validator
components.purpose: Evaluate explicitly reviewed valid, invalid, and ambiguous finding anchors against exact-SHA public Go source without pretending the repositories are exhaustively labeled.

components.name: Python Built-in Analyzer
owns: bounded scope-aware related-reference discovery for module-level functions
components.purpose: Provide deliberately narrow Python 3 semantic rules using the host standard-library ast parser with fail-closed parsing and conservative repository-aware reference evidence.

components.name: Pinned Public Python Validator
components.purpose: Run the Python analyzer against exact-SHA public Python repositories and enforce provenance, parser completeness, finding safety boundaries, and bounded reviewed anchors.

components.name: Deterministic Verification Contract
components.purpose: Freeze one pre-repair analyzer finding baseline and verify post-repair analyzer-visible resolution without executing repository commands.

components.name: Thin Agent Skill Adapter
components.purpose: Provide model-neutral orchestration instructions over the DoctorCode CLI while keeping all analysis and verification authority in the core.

components.name: Shared Application Facade
components.purpose: Expose audit, bounded context, pre-repair contract, and deterministic verify as one transport-neutral application surface.

components.name: Thin MCP Adapter
components.purpose: Expose the shared DoctorCode application facade as four read-only bounded MCP tools over local stdio.

components.name: Release and Install Pipeline
components.purpose: Build deterministic cross-platform DoctorCode/DoctorCode-MCP archives, bind release metadata and SHA-256 integrity, verify package contents, and support checksum-verifying installation.

data_flows.meaning: Audit dispatches the visible repository to registered deterministic analyzers.
Go source is parsed and narrow findings are generated with explicit confidence.
doctorcode next selects the highest-priority finding; doctorcode context selects one exact current finding ID; both reduce that finding to the same bounded packet.

The packet exposes the selected finding, primary excerpt, and budget-permitting related Go or Python excerpts; security excerpts remain omitted and unsupported languages keep primary-source-only context.
Manifest declares expected findings for isolated deterministic case roots.
Analyzer findings are matched against labels and converted into TP, FP, and FN counts.
Threshold result is a blocking regression gate on all three supported CI operating systems.
M03 adds independent shadowing, selector-collision, parenthesis, inverse-boolean, raw-string, and negative-control cases.
M04 exercises multi-file, multi-package, test-package, build-tag, assembly, generated-file, and nested-path interactions without changing detector rules.
GitHub Actions checks out four permissively licensed repositories at exact tracked SHAs.
Original public repository trees are analyzed directly without copying them into DoctorCode.
Checkout provenance, parse/analyze success, known-live anchors, relative paths, and no-autofix invariants are blocking on all three operating systems.
Tracked labels declare exact source locations as VALID_FINDING, INVALID_FINDING, or AMBIGUOUS with written rationale.
Exact-SHA source provenance plus valid/invalid label assertions are blocking on Linux, Windows, and macOS; ambiguous labels never authorize mutation.
When .py files and a compatible interpreter are present, source is parsed by a bounded standard-library AST subprocess and converted into deterministic findings.
Six isolated Python cases cover one positive per DoctorCode category plus conservative negatives.
Python findings are matched against the M07 labeled corpus through the same deterministic TP/FP/FN harness.
GitHub Actions checks out click, httpx, requests, and Flask at exact tracked SHAs and provisions Python 3.13.
Original public .py trees are parsed directly; parse failure is blocking and no external repository text becomes project authority.
Exact SHA, parse/analyze success, safe finding boundaries, and the bounded Flask anchor are blocking on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
Ten Python edge cases challenge identity semantics, module-name collisions, dynamic/export references, placeholder security values, and generated source behavior.

Fourteen mini-repositories exercise src layouts, direct package re-exports, relative/alias/dotted imports, tests, generated references, namespace packages, TYPE_CHECKING, conditional imports, and same-name package isolation.
For an eligible selected Go finding, the related provider supplies deterministic same-package production/test reference locations for bounded excerpt inclusion.
For an eligible selected Python finding, the related provider supplies deterministic bounded production/test reference locations for packet inclusion.
Before repair, doctorcode contract freezes analyzer identities plus target-path semantic finding counts for one exact selected finding.
doctorcode verify performs a fresh deterministic audit of the current repository state without executing repository-provided commands.
Verification reports PASS only when the semantic target occurrence count decreases and no same-or-higher-severity target-path regression is introduced.
The agent loads a bounded workflow contract when code diagnosis or repair needs DoctorCode evidence.
The skill invokes the existing audit, context, contract, and verify surfaces; it does not reproduce their algorithms.
A client invokes one of four bounded read-only DoctorCode tools; repository scope is fixed when the server starts.
The adapter translates typed MCP input/results and delegates DoctorCode semantics to the same application authority used by the CLI.
Exact accepted source plus version/commit/build-date metadata is cross-compiled into target archives.
Checksummed archives and installers deliver doctorcode, doctorcode-mcp, license, README, and Agent Skill without changing core authority.

external_boundaries.contract: Linux, Windows, and macOS hosted runners are acceptance authority.
external_boundaries.name: GitHub Actions

external_boundaries.contract: Compiler/runtime availability is observed, never assumed.
external_boundaries.name: Host toolchains

external_boundaries.contract: Each language declares semantic coverage separately; recognition alone never implies analyzer support.
external_boundaries.name: Future language analyzers

external_boundaries.contract: Benchmark case roots must remain under the manifest directory, and Go source symlink entries are not followed during repository analysis.
external_boundaries.name: Repository filesystem boundary

external_boundaries.contract: External source is untrusted read-only analysis input. Repository identity is fixed by exact SHA and license metadata; its documentation or instructions do not become DoctorCode authority.
external_boundaries.name: Pinned public repositories

external_boundaries.contract: Python semantic analysis is optional during normal audit. M07 acceptance explicitly provisions Python 3.13; the implementation accepts Python 3.8+ but broader runtime-version compatibility is not claimed by this milestone.
external_boundaries.name: Host Python semantic runtime

external_boundaries.contract: External Python source is untrusted read-only analysis input fixed by exact SHA and license metadata; repository comments/docs/instructions never become DoctorCode authority.
external_boundaries.name: Pinned public Python repositories

external_boundaries.contract: Source excerpts are read only after resolving repository root and finding path symlinks and confirming the resolved target remains inside the repository root.
external_boundaries.name: Evidence source filesystem boundary

external_boundaries.contract: M12 follows only enclosing top-level non-method functions and references in the same directory/package. Local shadow bindings and external test packages are excluded; no full type-checker or transitive graph is claimed.
external_boundaries.name: Go related-context boundary

external_boundaries.contract: M13 follows only module-level functions, same-file unshadowed direct references, and recognized top-level import forms. Dynamic imports, package-facade re-export chains, string reflection, runtime monkey-patching, and transitive graphs are not claimed; selected-name module rebinding fails closed.
external_boundaries.name: Python related-context boundary

external_boundaries.contract: M14 never executes repository-provided test, build, shell, hook, or Finding.Verification command strings. Verification authority is a fresh DoctorCode deterministic audit plus the frozen contract only.
external_boundaries.name: Verification execution boundary

external_boundaries.contract: Skill prose may sequence DoctorCode CLI operations and restate proof limits but cannot create findings, expand evidence, authorize mutation, or override verification results.
external_boundaries.name: Skill adapter authority boundary
MCP transport boundary
external_boundaries.contract: M16 proves local stdio transport only. Tool schemas cannot select repository root/path or execute arbitrary commands; all four tools are read-only and preserve underlying DoctorCode proof boundaries.

external_boundaries.name: Release integrity boundary
external_boundaries.contract: Installers verify SHA-256 from the published checksums file before extraction. This is integrity relative to the release channel, not code-signing or hardware-backed provenance.
